_comment: Island-scale topic (docs/24 §2.4, §4.6 C1/C1b): no sovereign base; control areas are today's reservoir water surfaces (URA MP2019 land use, named via OpenStreetMap), filtered per keyframe by the year each reservoir was completed (PUB / NLB). Expansions before today's outline and vanished water bodies are known gaps, never drawn.

ura-landuse.title: Master Plan 2019 Land Use layer
ura-landuse.author: Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), via data.gov.sg
ura-landuse.role: today's reservoir water surfaces (LU_DESC = RESERVOIR), the control areas of every keyframe

ura-planning-area.title: Master Plan 2019 Planning Area Boundary (No Sea)
ura-planning-area.author: Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), via data.gov.sg
ura-planning-area.role: dissolved into today's island outline: the local basemap public/geo/land-sg.json (local-land.ts)

osm-water.title: OpenStreetMap: named reservoirs of Singapore and Linggiu Reservoir (Johor), Overpass export
osm-water.author: © OpenStreetMap contributors
osm-water.role: reservoir names and outlines that select the URA waterbody parcels of each reservoir; Linggiu Reservoir's outline (outside the URA data)

osm-lines.title: OpenStreetMap: Johor River, water pipelines and the Johor–Singapore Causeway, Overpass export
osm-lines.author: © OpenStreetMap contributors
osm-lines.role: waypoints of the pipeline routes in movements.json (data/SOURCES.md, Movement routes)
